Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo, ordering a 3D-printed viking chess set from his friend: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing. First line: proud and demanding, a little vain, pointing at his own red-and-white suit on the last two words. Second line: amazed and delighted, he just recognised himself in a chess piece, almost laughing.
lines: Lo quiero rojo y blanco. ¡Como yo!

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, repainting a chess set with a magic gesture. First line: warm and clear, explaining while he casts the spell. Second line: proud, showing off a detail. Third line: completely deadpan and dry, a little pause after 'Bueno'. Last line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer.
lines: Elegís los colores de cada bando.
¿Qué colores le pondrías vos? Comentá colores y te paso precio y fecha.

_note: the automatic split put '¿Qué colores le pondrías vos?' into m3: m3 and m4 were re-cut from the take at the measured pauses; m4's pause between its two sentences shortened
